result.question: Compare the net income of Apple and Nvidia in their most recent fiscal years.
result.answer: In their most recent fiscal years, Nvidia's net income exceeded Apple's. Apple reported net income of $112,010,000,000 (approximately $112.0 billion) for its fiscal year 2025, which ended on September 27, 2025 [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2025-09-27]. Nvidia reported net income of $120,067,000,000 (approximately $120.1 billion) for its fiscal year 2026, which ended on January 25, 2026 [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2026-01-25]. Apple's fiscal year ends on the last Saturday of September [0000320193-25-000057:part-i--item-1-p004], while Nvidia's fiscal year ends on the last Sunday in January [0001045810-25-000230:part-i--item-1-p005], so the two companies' most recent fiscal years cover different calendar periods.
